content.bridge_context: Building on basic food habits from earlier grades, we now look at food as a chemical source of energy and repair through Nutrients.

units.title: What are Nutrients?
units.explanation: Nutrients are the essential chemical substances in food that our body needs to grow and stay healthy.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify different nutrients like Carbohydrates, Proteins, and Fats. / कार्बोहाइड्रेट, प्रोटीन और वसा जैसे विभिन्न पोषक तत्वों की पहचान करें।

units.title: A Balanced Diet
units.explanation: A diet that contains all the nutrients in the right amount along with roughage and water.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss why eating only one type of food is bad. / चर्चा करें कि केवल एक ही प्रकार का भोजन करना बुरा क्यों है।
